messages:
alex: Quick sync — token-cost attribution pipeline: who owns the final event schema and the mapping from model/quantization -> cost buckets? Need to finalize before Wed so Billing can consume. cc @maria @tyler

maria: I can own the event schema and the docs. working on a draft now, will post shortly.

tyler: I can own the ETL / attribution mapping and the cost bucketing logic. PR in progress, will push today.

jamie: Two quick asks from infra/observability side: 1) we need a stable `request_id` and `model_variant` fields on each event; 2) include `batch_size` so latency/cost per-token calculations are accurate.

maria: Agreed re: `request_id` and `model_variant`. Draft schema (very small example):
```json
{
  "event": "inference.finish",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "model_id": "redwood-v1",
  "model_variant": "redwood-v1-int8",
  "quantization": "int8",
  "tokens_generated": 120,
  "token_cost": 0.0024,
  "latency_ms": 220,
  "batch_size": 1,
  "timestamp": "2024-11-01T15:32:00Z"
}
```

alex: That looks good. Maria, please add the final JSON schema to the docs site under /analytics/events and mark required vs optional.

maria: Will do. Quick question: should `token_cost` be emitted by the runtime or calculated downstream in ETL?

tyler: For accuracy, runtime should emit `tokens_generated` and `model_variant`. ETL will apply the pricing table (which maps model_variant -> per_token_price) and write `token_cost` into the billing table. We'll keep `token_cost` optional in the event (ETL will backfill).

nora: FYI — billing wants a nightly export of attribution by customer and model_variant. Tyler, can your mapping include org_id and customer_id join keys?

tyler: Yes, the ETL will join on `org_id` present in the event. If any service won't include it, we'll add a fallback join using request metadata.

jamie: Also, API latency breakdown: can we add `server_processing_ms` and `network_ms` if available? Even coarse buckets are helpful.

maria: I'll add optional fields `server_processing_ms` and `network_ms` to the schema with notes that they're best-effort.

alex: Checklist before Wed: 
- [ ] Final schema committed to docs (maria)
- [ ] ETL mapping + pricing table PR (tyler)
- [ ] Add `request_id` validation in runtime (eng-runtime)
- [ ] Nightly export spec for Billing (tyler + billing)

tyler: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 — PTAL @maria @jamie. A couple of unit tests failing on CI (mocking org_id) but local pass.

maria: Looking now. quick nits on field names (camelCase vs snake_case) — we should standardize. I prefer snake_case for event payloads.

jamie: We standardize on snake_case in telemetry events across infra. +1 to maria.

t tyler: (typo) noted — will switch to snake_case and force-push.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for telemetry-etl v1.3 on prod-canary at 1742001500 :rocket:

alex: Great. Tyler — after you fix naming and tests, ping here and i'll add to the project board and mark owner. Maria — once schema is pushed i'll link it in the billing ticket and send to billing for sign-off.

maria: Uploaded schema to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/analytics/events#inference.finish — link includes required/optional fields.

tyler: Force-pushed with snake_case; CI green now. PR updated.

alex: Thanks team — plan: finalize Wed 11:00am sync if anything blocks, otherwise we'll proceed with ETL rollout and nightly export. :thumbsup:
